text: Residents on Victory Drive, between Wintergreen Road and Julian Road, report concerns with obstructions caused by vehicles stopped on the north side of the street. Based on the current pavement width, there is generally not sufficient space to provide parking on both sides of the street and maintain two-way traffic. The proposed amendments will prevent loading/unloading and vehicles displaying accessible permits from parking on the north side of the street, enhancing the flow of traffic and the sightlines in the horizontal curve.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Victory Drive, between Ianhall Road and Julian Road, to operate between Ianhall Road and Wintergreen Road. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Victory Drive, between Wintergreen Road and Julian Road.
